{{Quote|&hellip; a rancor foaming at the mouth&hellip;|[[Mandalore the Vindicated]], speaking about Mavrix Varad|<ref name="VaradCodex" />}}
'''Mavrix Varad''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Soldier/Legends|warrior]] who lived during the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a conflict waged between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|My uncle taught me how to deal with snivelers like you. The ones who couldn't fight, who always tried to talk their way out of their failures instead. He used to let me hunt them, before I even passed my verd'goten. Mavrix did a lot of things wrong when he led Clan Varad, but not this. Cutting out the weak, before they could infect the rest of us, that was one of the things he got right.|[[Tyrus Brokenblade]]|<ref name="TOR:TB">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Tyrus Brokenblade}}</ref>}}
The [[Chief/Legends|chieftain]] of [[Clan Varad]], Mavrix was considered [[Blood/Legends|bloodthirsty]] by his peers, and led his clan in numerous raids from their hidden compounds in the [[Tamarin sector/Legends|Tamarin sector]]. Varad forced his clan kinsmen to face harsh combat trials, and those who did not live up to his high standards were left for [[Unarmed combat/Legends|sparring]] or hunting practice for the clan's younger members. Varad's radical ideas clashed with those of the reigning [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|''Mand'alor'']], [[Mandalore the Vindicated]], who held a low opinion of Varad and banned members of his clan from the Mandalorian-held stronghold of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]].<ref name="VaradCodex" />

In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates" /> Clan Varad hijacked the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] battle ship ''[[Allusis]]''. Mavrix Varad and most of his men were killed during the subsequent [[Battle for the Allusis|battle]] for the control of the ship.<ref name="TOR:MR" />

Mavrix Varad's nephew, [[Tyrus Brokenblade]], later succeeded Mavrix as leader of Clan Varad.<ref name="TOR:TB" />

{{Mando-stub}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|You're worthy opponents but this ship belongs to Clan Varad! Time for you to die|Mavrix Varad confronting the forces send by the Republic and Sith Empire|<ref name="Flashpoint">{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|Mandalorian Raiders}}</ref>}}
Mavrix was bloodthirsty and battle hungry for war, causing him have fights with Mandalore the Vindicated who thought him nothing more of a rancor with a foaming mouth.<ref name="VaradCodex" />

Mavrix Varad only expected the best of his warriors of his clan, those who do not meet his standards would end up finding themselves becoming hunting or sparring practice for younger members of Varad. His bloodthirsty nature would cause him grow restless when the Republic and Sith Empire signed the treaty. He eventually made the decision to break off from Mandalore's leadership and turn against him.<ref name="VaradCodex" /> However despite all of his dishonorable and radical traits, when confronted by the Republic and Sith Empire before then being defeated by them, he showed no fear of death.<ref name="TOR:MR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mavrix Varad first appeared in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity in the [[BioWare]]-made [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR:MR" />
